website.pipeline_url_status: 404 — no dedicated pipeline page; corporate site documents only the approved kidneyintelX.dkd product

ctgov.note: All 4 sponsor-matched studies are observational/registry-style or otherwise not phase I-III interventional drug trials.

commercial_product.name: kidneyintelX.dkd
commercial_product.modality: In-vitro diagnostic (IVD); blood-based bioprognostic test combining serum biomarkers (sTNFR1, sTNFR2, KIM-1) with EHR features (uACR, HbA1c, BUN) via a machine-learning algorithm
commercial_product.indication: Risk stratification of progressive kidney function decline in adults with type 2 diabetes and stage 1-3b chronic kidney disease (diabetic kidney disease)
commercial_product.regulatory_status: FDA De Novo marketing authorization granted Q2 2023; Medicare final coverage determination June 2024 at $950 per reportable test; included as a risk assessment tool in KDIGO 2024 CKD Clinical Practice Guideline

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Renalytix is a diagnostics company. Its sole product is the FDA-authorized kidneyintelX.dkd in-vitro diagnostic for diabetic kidney disease risk stratification. The 10-K, corporate website, and ClinicalTrials.gov sponsor search disclose no active interventional Phase 1/2/3 drug or device trials of company-owned therapeutic candidates.
